title: KHEPRI-DC-FB v1.0: Data-centre queues against flow-based import limits in the Norwegian bidding zones: a preregistered descriptive analysis
description: Preregistered descriptive analysis. In how many market time units would the data-centre queue in each Norwegian bidding zone (NO1–NO5), added as load in the zone, need more import than the published flow-based minimum net position allows? Period: 2024-10-30 to 2026-10-31. Import headroom is the realised day-ahead net position minus the minimum net position from the Nordic flow-based capacity calculation (source: JAO Nordic Publication Tool, https://publicationtool.jao.eu). A secondary measure adds regulable hydropower that was not producing (ENTSO-E); it is an optimistic upper bound. The outcomes are descriptive and say nothing about actual security of supply, prices or connection capacity. The methods were locked in the signed git tag prereg-v1 before any outcome was computed. The preregistration was submitted to OSF Registries with a selected embargo until 31.12.2027; publication does not wait for OSF (deviation A3). Deviations A1–A3 are documented in AVVIK_FRA_PREREG.md. The record contains code with retrieval scripts, tests, outcome tables, the manuscript, the ground-truth register and OpenTimestamps files. It contains no JAO raw data or JAO time series, and no copies of third-party source documents; these are listed with URL and sha256 in manuskript/sources.csv.
